reason: Use a Tier 2 change: separate prediction-aligned final-mask training from auxiliary history corruption. Increasing negatives and adding relative biases failed to exceed 0.5800, while recent-item fusion recovered only part of the loss; this supports testing a different representation issue rather than adding more capacity. Currently, auxiliary masking removes historical context from the final query during training, whereas inference supplies intact history, potentially weakening both the Transformer and recent-item path.

Construct the clean view before historical corruption so its visible context matches prediction_sequence; keep the final target hidden in both views and exclude its label from auxiliary supervision. This isolates training-context mismatch without changing inference inputs or accessing validation items during training.
